places.label: destinations
item_structure: 2-3 engaging sentences on why travellers should experience this place.
Scenery, history and character in 2-3 natural sentences (use historical_info only if present).
One concise sentence, based on best_time_to_visit.
Only if nearest_place_to_visit has data; otherwise omit this sub-section.
One practical sentence based on dos/donts or timings.
extra_sections: Practical road / rail / local transport guidance using the ROUTE lines in the data.
Ideal seasons and weather for these places.
Money-saving advice (entry fees only if present in the data).
5-7 FAQs. Each question is a ### heading ending with '?' followed by a short answer paragraph.

activities.label: activities
item_structure: 2-3 sentences describing the experience (use description / highlights).
One sentence using suitable_for, minimum_age and difficulty_level.
One sentence with duration and average_cost + currency, only if present.
extra_sections: How to reach the activity locations using transport data if available.
Booking advice and safety guidance, grounded in the data.
5-7 FAQs. Each question is a ### heading ending with '?' followed by a short answer paragraph.

events.label: events and festivals
item_structure: 2-3 sentences using description, category and recurrence.
One sentence with start_date/end_date, venue and village.
Crowd, tickets (ticket_price / ticket_required) and atmosphere in 2 sentences.
Only if nearby_attractions has data; otherwise omit.
extra_sections: How to Plan Your Festival Trip
Practical planning advice: booking early, transport, stays.
Best Time to Visit {region} for Events
Month-by-month overview built ONLY from the events given.
Respectful and safe behaviour at cultural events.
5-7 FAQs. Each question is a ### heading ending with '?' followed by a short answer paragraph.

food.label: restaurants and food experiences
item_structure: 2-3 sentences on atmosphere and cuisine (Cuisine types, Restaurant type, Description).
Use Popular dishes only; do not invent dishes.
One sentence using Price range (for two) and opening/closing time if present.
One sentence using Village and Nearest beach / landmark.
extra_sections: Overview of the cuisines represented in the data.
Use the Veg / Non Veg field.
5-7 FAQs. Each question is a ### heading ending with '?' followed by a short answer paragraph.

stay.label: places to stay
item_structure: One sentence naming key amenities from the data.
price_per_night + currency, village and nearest_beach, only if present.
extra_sections: How to Choose Where to Stay in {region}
Guidance on regions and budgets using only the data.
Seasonal advice and pricing patterns if supported by the data.
5-7 FAQs. Each question is a ### heading ending with '?' followed by a short answer paragraph.
